commits.author: xsyetopz
commits.body:
Solid draws are static geometry, so fur_shell_reject never fires in them, but the discard made the generic early solid program one that can discard. On MoltenVK that is depth tested after it runs, and over the reused EQUAL depth it drew a few pixels unlike the specialised solid program (OPENRAC_STATIC_COLOUR, no fur). render_equivalence_vulkan's shader-variants comparisons differed in up to 1.4% of pixels on an M1 Max; with this, none do.

commits.headline: feat(sdk): let any mod turn the hero's joints, each mod's offsets composed (#384)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
hero_set_joints took offsets only from the mod holding the hero's update
hook, so a mod that keeps the game's movement (the lock-strafe's hip
twist) could not use it. Each mod's offsets are now kept apart and handed
to the hero together, each mod's composed after the ones set before it;
a mod's go when it is dropped and all go on reset. hero_set_pose still
needs the hook. mod_loader covers a mod without the hook.

commits.headline: fix(rac2): read the table func_L00_002D5E30 forms as the table plus 2 (#394)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The retail code forms 0x00262262 (lui 0x26; addiu 0x2262, then lh -2),
never the table's own address, so the level programs' relocation, paired
on the operands the code forms, had no pair for D_L00_00262260. formed_as
names the sum each release forms (v1.01 and PAL 0x00262262, v2.00
0x002621E2, under the name its build gives the table), and a level's
datum named that way is now the sum as that level has it, less the
addition.

commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
The Windows job fails in the clang-windows step on develop and on pull
requests. Cache the installer, try a bad download up to five times with
a growing wait, log the size and SHA-256 of a bad file, and find 7-Zip
by its install path if it is not on PATH.

commits.headline: perf(baker): bake Enhanced lighting faster (#391)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
* perf(baker): spread the medial skeleton's reach from each new branch only

Each branch of a room's skeleton recomputed the geodesic distance from every
selected node, a full Dijkstra over the room per branch. The distance only
falls as branches join, so a pass from the new branch alone gives the same
values. Level 9 (NTSC) bakes in 48 s instead of 102 s, every output byte the same.
